important_uncertainties: Benign masochism is used as an interpretive framework, not a settled single neural mechanism.
Sensation-seeking findings are correlational/moderating evidence, not a universal cause of spicy-food liking.
Endogenous opioids can contribute to pleasant pain relief, but the project does not claim an established causal chain from capsaicin to an endorphin high to learned spicy-food preference.
The 2025 fMRI comparison is small and cross-sectional, so it is used as evidence consistent with experience-dependent hedonic processing, not proof of causation.
